weight.description: Edge weight (reinforced by reciprocal exchange, decays over time)

one_directional_exchanges.description: Count of one-directional exchanges (requested but not delivered back)

trigger.description: Event that activates this edge (e.g., 'Sales.Head KR-03 status change')

required_data.description: Data required for the handoff to complete

acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria for the receiver to act on the handoff

sla.description: Service level agreement timing (e.g., 'within 1 review cycle')

exception_path.description: Escalation path if handoff is not acknowledged (e.g., 'REQUEST escalates to Sales.Head')
